description: This file defines the 'Statistics' model class for the OpenCart admin reporting system, providing methods to retrieve and modify statistical data stored in the database.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Model class for handling statistical data, with methods to get, add, remove, and edit statistics values.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves all statistics records from the database.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given statistic code.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a specified value to an existing statistic identified by the code.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Removes a specified value from an existing statistic identified by the code.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Replaces the value of an existing statistic with a new value.
